sources: Long Heritage (WeaponBasicTable wpn_claym_0019, greatsword). Its Intellect and Cryo DMG lines and sk_wpn_claym_0019's main attribute +primary_attr_up (cardAttributeModifier attribute 2, formulaItem 6, modifyAttributeType 1) are on the stat panel. Skill 3 "Efficacy: Secret History", rmxlinux Json/SkillData/sk_wpn_claym_0019 passiveEventActions, values from SkillPatchTable at the weapon's skill-3 level (level 9: cryst_dmg_up 0.168, spell_dmg_up 0.112, duration and duration2 20 s). It fits Si (Cryo or Heat battle-skill infliction, a team Cryo and Heat Amp); on Mi Fu (no infliction, no Amp) nothing fires. Batch-4 report docs/kit-batches/batch-4/chr_0031_mifu.md rows E8–E12.

abilityEvent 126 (the wielder applies an Arts Infliction) + CheckOriginSkillType [2] (battle skill) + CheckSpellInflictionType mask 5 (Heat, Cryo) → buff_wpn_claym_0019_teamspell (targetSource 4 with a CharacterTeamFinder: the wielder): "When the wielder's battle skill applies Cryo Infliction or Heat Infliction, the wielder gains Cryo DMG Dealt +{cryst_dmg_up} for {duration}s". An infliction that forms a reaction isn't an inflictionApplied event (open: in-game test 35).

abilityEvent 102 (the wielder applies a buff) + CheckBuffIdInContext checkType 1 (ID list buff_common_affixes_enhance_crystal, tag query 486772476: Arts Amp, only on _enhance_spell and _enhance_all) + NotNext CheckTargetsEqual(wielder, the buff's target) → buff_wpn_claym_0019_teamatk on the team (targetSource 3): "When the wielder grants Arts Amp to another operator in the team, the entire team gains Arts DMG Dealt +{spell_dmg_up} for {duration2}s".

buffs.label: Secret History: Cryo DMG
buffs.note: BuffData buff_wpn_claym_0019_teamspell: attribute 53 (Cryo DMG) cryst_dmg_up; stackingType 11 with a priority key, maxStackCnt 1 (the loader reads it: a reapplication refreshes).

buffs.label: Secret History: team Arts DMG
buffs.note: BuffData buff_wpn_claym_0019_teamatk: attributes 51–54 (Heat, Electric, Cryo, Nature DMG) spell_dmg_up; stackingType 11 priority, maxStackCnt 1. Two wielders' copies add up here (batch-3 B2 residue, minor).

triggers.note: beforeDamage: the infliction comes with its SpellInfliction, before the DamageAction that carries it (Si's chr_0036_jsspsi_normal_skill_abilityrange_1), so the inflicting hit already has the Cryo DMG (in-game test 51's question).

Read as checkType 1 = the ID list or the tag query: a Cryo Amp (buff_common_affixes_enhance_crystal, what Si's ultimate grants with its Heat Amp) or an all-Arts one (tag 486772476), i.e. an Amp reaching Cryo; toOthers: it reaches someone other than the wielder (NotNext CheckTargetsEqual). If checkType 1 is the tag query only, this becomes `tags: [486772476]` and Si's Amp doesn't count: in-game test 92 (report E11; batch-4 T1's open reading).
